name: Graduation Letter
description: Click to choose an elemental specialization, losing the graduation letter in the process.
flavor: The end of one journey, and the beginning of another. Perhaps it's time to break the seal and choose your elemental specialization.

name: Magus Staff
description:
Gains a charge for every 5 cards played.
Click an elemental orb to convert a charge into one point of that element.
Starts each battle with 1 charge.
flavor: A mysterious staff the elementalist found on their person upon waking. It feels important somehow...
